evidence.title: GDELT DOC API one-year stage-1 path
evidence.reason: Current official DOC documentation limits precise date search to a rolling three-month window; GitHub Hosted Runner also returned persistent HTTP 429 before any regression result was generated.

evidence.title: GDELT Goldstein/Tone/mentions and next-day USD/INR
evidence.key_result: Tone passed the circular-shift placebo at p≈0.0495 and had 100% fold sign stability, but BH q≈0.3945 and OOS RMSE deteriorated by≈3.43%.

evidence.title: Ten GDELT news states and five macro assets
evidence.key_result: Six apparent relations vanish under family-level FDR and the full placebo/OOS/stability gate.

evidence.title: Post-selection audit of US mentions to DXY five-day return
evidence.key_result: The nominal candidate is period-dependent, non-monotonic by decile and supported by only six non-overlapping z≥2 events whose matched-control interval crosses zero.

evidence.title: One-to-twenty-day local projection exploration
evidence.key_result: No horizon coefficient survives feature-family or target-global FDR.

evidence.title: Bidirectional news-market lag exploration
evidence.key_result: Neither direction has a relation surviving direction-family FDR.

evidence.title: Significance enrichment diagnostic across 1,500 tests
evidence.key_result: Nominal significance is not enriched beyond the global-null expectation; none of 200 preregistered tests passes the unadjusted joint placebo/OOS/stability gate.

evidence.title: Fourteen-day verified GDELT daily Event raw pilot
required_gates: Silver Parquet and global/country/bilateral Gold outputs
